content:
maria: Heads-up 4 April release aiming for 11:00am PT publish. Need a single changelog link, docs anchor, and rollout cadence confirmed by EOD.

jon: Were good for progressive rollout: canary at 10:30am PT (5%), then 50% at 10:45, 100% by 11:00 if metrics look good. Ops will watch p50/p95 and error rate.

kim: Docs PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/530  includes migration notes. Waiting for perf blurb from eng.

maria: Marketing wants one-line headline + one supporting stat for the post. Can eng supply a short sentence we can paste?

jon: Draft: "New batching and cache warms improve median latency ~22% and lower per-1k token cost ~20%." Ill add exact numbers after the benchmark run.

ops-bot: Release window created: 2026-04-14T17:30:00Z -> 2026-04-14T18:15:00Z. Runbook: /runbooks/release-2026-04-14.

maria: Webinar on Wed 9:00am PT. Need a 2-min perf clip + one-slide summary for email. Who records?

jon: I can record a short terminal demo and upload to the shared drive by tomorrow AM.

salesops: For lead routing use tag "apr_release_2026". Please ensure webforms and webinar regs add this hidden field so leads auto-tag. SLA: 48h response.

kim: Docs merged and anchor created when perf blurb is in; will publish immediately and share link here.

maria: Great. Final publish plan: 11:00am PT post, 11:05 social, 11:10 email. Marketing will hold the send until ops gives green. Ping this thread when changelog + docs are live.

jon: Bench done: median 132ms -> 103ms; p95 380ms -> 290ms; cost per 1k tokens $0.46 -> $0.37. Dropping these into the docs PR now.

ops-bot: Canary started (EU). Monitor channel: #release-watch. Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/70001.

maria: Copy. Waiting on green to publish. Thanks team!
